tests.text: Horizontal touch dragging controls the squad.
Passing +5 with 1 soldier results in 6 soldiers.
Passing ×3 with 6 soldiers results in 18 soldiers.
Passing -4 with 18 soldiers results in 14 soldiers.
Passing ÷2 with 5 soldiers results in 2 soldiers.
A mathematical gate activates only once.
Only one gate per gate group can activate.
Soldier count reaching zero causes defeat.
Each soldier contributes to shooting damage.

Obstacle collisions remove the correct
number of soldiers.

Boss health decreases according
to actual projectile hits.
Boss health reaching zero causes victory.

Reaching the end with Boss HP above zero
causes defeat.
Completing a level unlocks the next level.

Restarting restores the level's original
temporary state.
Gold and upgrades persist after refresh.

The game does not require runtime
third-party API calls.

The game remains functional with
200 soldiers.

Restarting repeatedly does not create
duplicate update loops.
Game resources are cleaned up correctly.

Mathematical gates change soldier count,
not weapon count.
Squad growth visibly increases total firepower.
The player can choose between gate alternatives.
Enemies and hazards reduce squad effectiveness.
Boss combat and victory conditions work.
The game uses the required warfare theme.
